the puzzles are very rule-consistent. "/" appeared since is it defined as negative sign.

69/52 = rev(rev(52) - rev(69)) = rev(25 - 96) = rev(-71) = 17- => 17/

52}51 = rev(rev(52) + rev(51) - 1) = rev(25 + 15 -1) = rev(39) = 93
